name: Béa Dynamic Wardrobe & Context System
principle: Béa's core identity never changes: small white French bulldog + lemon bandana. Contextual accessories are functional, weather/activity-based, and culturally neutral.
forbiddenOrDefaultAvoid: traditional, ceremonial, religious, indigenous, ethnic, or national dress used as costume
head coverings with religious or cultural significance
skin, fur, eye, facial or body changes meant to signal ethnicity or nationality
fake accents, dialect mimicry, or phonetic stereotypes
food, alcohol, body features, poverty, crime, or religion used as shorthand for a nationality or ethnicity
flag costumes or wrapping Béa in a national flag
military uniforms tied to a nationality as novelty costume
tourist stereotypes such as berets/sombreros/lederhosen/geisha-inspired styling as destination shorthand
destination-specific costume generated solely from country/city name
destinationContextRules: Prefer weather and activity over destination identity.
If destination flavor is desired, use neutral environmental cues such as map route, transit iconography, architecture silhouettes, coastline, mountains, or generic cityscape — not cultural costume.
Use named landmarks only when they are relevant to the user's trip and visually appropriate; do not parody them.
Do not infer culture, religion, ethnicity, language style or dress from a destination.
Do not auto-generate culturally specific attire from location metadata.
If a culturally specific visual is ever requested, treat it as a separate reviewed content/design task rather than part of the automatic wardrobe system.

sampleLines: Wet paws have entered the risk assessment.
Rain detected. Béa has concerns about paw conditions.
Warm. Sunny. Béa sees no reason to rush.
Béa came prepared. Emotionally, for snacks.
There is elevation involved. Béa was not consulted.
Béa has packed. Mostly unnecessary things.
Airport mode activated. Dignity is carry-on only.
Béa supports sleep. Airports do not.
Overnight flight detected. Béa is already tired on your behalf.
Béa has no idea what’s happening but supports cake.

implementation.preferredModel: base character animation + optional accessory/prop layer
implementation.avoid: pre-rendering every possible action × outfit combination
implementation.fallback: If a clean aligned overlay is unavailable for a pose, use default Béa rather than forcing a bad costume fit.
